name: Gateway Shopping Center
summary: Gateway Shopping Center is Westchester County's premier open-air shopping destination featuring major anchors like Target, Whole Foods Market, ULTA Beauty, and Old Navy. This community-focused center offers a compelling mix of grocery, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle retail serving the New York-Connecticut border region.
demographics: Gateway Shopping Center attracts a diverse, affluent suburban demographic from Westchester County, NY and nearby Fairfield County, CT. The primary trade area consists of upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes exceeding $100,000, drawn to the center's health-conscious and lifestyle-oriented tenant mix including Whole Foods and fitness options. The shopper base skews toward adults aged 30-55 who prioritize quality, convenience, and wellness-focused retail experiences. The location at the New York-Connecticut border creates a unique cross-state market appeal, attracting shoppers seeking premium grocery, beauty, and everyday essentials in an accessible open-air format.
description: Gateway Shopping Center stands as Westchester County's premier open-air shopping and dining destination, strategically located at 421 Boston Post Road in Port Chester, New York. This community-focused center has established itself as the gateway to healthy living, individual style, and everyday inspiration for residents across the New York-Connecticut border region. The center features an impressive lineup of anchor tenants including Target, Whole Foods Market, ULTA Beauty, and Old Navy, creating a compelling mix of grocery, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle retail under one roof. As an open-air shopping environment, Gateway offers visitors a pleasant and accessible shopping experience with ample parking and easy navigation between stores. The center's commitment to serving the community is evident in its diverse tenant mix that balances fitness, dining, and retail options, all designed to meet the everyday needs of local families and professionals while maintaining a focus on quality and convenience.
